```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(wooldridge)
```

## Simple regression

```{r}
campus <- get(data(campus)) |> 
  mutate(
    police = round((police/enroll) * 1000, 2),
    crime = round((crime/enroll) * 1000, 2)
  )
```

```{r}
{
  set.seed(123)
  campus_10 <- campus[sample(1:97, 10),]
  campus_10 <- select(campus_10, police, crime)
  t(campus_10)
}
```

```{r}
summary(lm(formula = 'crime ~ police', data = campus_10))
```

```{r}
campus_10 %>% 
  lm(
    formula = 'crime ~ police',
    data = .
  ) |> 
  summary()
```

## Samme regresjon «for hånd»

```{r}
beta_2 <- campus_10 |> 
  mutate(
    x = police, 
    y = crime, 
    xy = x * y
  ) |> 
  summarise(
    beta_2 = (sum(xy) - 10 * mean(y) * mean(x))/(sum(x^2) - 10 * mean(x)^2)
  ) |> 
  pull()

beta_2
```

```{r}
# beta_1 = \bar{y} - beta_2 * \bar{x}
beta_1 <- campus_10 |> 
  mutate(
    x = police, 
    y = crime
  ) |> 
  summarise(beta_1 = mean(y) - beta_2 * mean(x)) |> 
  pull()

beta_1
```

```{r}
lm_police <-campus %>% 
  lm(
    'crime ~police',
    data = .
  )
```

```{r}
fitted_data <- tibble(
police = campus$police,
crime_mod = fitted(lm_police)
)

fitted_data  |> 
ggplot() + 
geom_point(
  mapping = aes(x = police, y = crime_mod), 
  size = 2
  ) +
geom_point(
  data = campus, 
  mapping = aes(x = police, y = crime), 
  colour = 'blue', 
  alpha = 0.4
  ) +
geom_abline(
  intercept = coefficients(lm_police)[1],
  slope = coefficients(lm_police)[2]
  ) +
labs(title = "Scatterplot of campus data with fitted values and regression line.") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18)
    )
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = campus) + 
geom_point(
  mapping = aes(
    x = police, 
    y = pluck(lm('campus$crime ~ campus$police'), "fitted.values")
    ), 
  size = 2
  ) +
geom_point(
  data = campus, 
  mapping = aes(x = police, y = crime), 
  colour = 'blue', 
  alpha = 0.4
  ) +
geom_abline(
  intercept = coefficients(lm('campus$crime ~ campus$police'))[1],
  slope = coefficients(lm('campus$crime ~ campus$police'))[2]
  ) +
labs(
  title = "Scatterplot of campus data with fitted values and regression line."
  ) +
ylab("crime") +
xlab("police") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18)
    )
```

```{r}
#Gen Data 
df_earn <- tibble(
x = sample(8:20, 100, replace = TRUE),
y = -14 + 2.5*x + rnorm(100, 0, 5)) %>% 
filter(y > 5)

#Estimates 
lm_earn <- lm(y ~ x, data = df_earn)
#Save coefficients
b0_earn <- lm_earn$coefficients[1]
b1_earn <- lm_earn$coefficients[2]

# 1/(N-1)*sum(u_i * (X_i - mean(X)))
df_earn |> 
  summarise(1/(length(x) - 1) * (sum(residuals(lm_earn) * (x - mean(x)))) ) |> 
  pull()
```

```{r}
{set.seed(2222)
df1 <- tibble(
  x = rnorm(1000, 5, 5),
  y = 100 - 1*x + 
    rnorm(1000, 0, 10)
  ) 
}
```

```{r}
# same seed, higher (double) sd
set.seed(2222)
{df2 <- tibble(
  x = rnorm(1000, 5, 5),
  y = 100 - 1*x + 
    rnorm(1000, 0, 20)
  )
}
```

```{r}
cor(df1$x, df1$y)
```

```{r}
round(cor(df1$x, df1$y)^2, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
cor(df2$x, df2$y)
```

```{r}
round(cor(df2$x, df2$y)^2, digits = 2)
```

```{r}
g021 <- df1 |> 
  ggplot() +
  xlim(-15,25) + 
  ylim(0, 160) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x, y), color = "blue", alpha = 0.5, 
    size = 2
  ) +
  stat_smooth(
    formula = 'y ~ x', data = df1, aes(x, y), 
    method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", 
    linewidth = 2
    ) +
  labs(title = 
    as.expression(bquote(~ R^2 == ~ 
  .(round(summary(lm(y~x, df1))$r.squared, 2))))
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18)
    )
```

```{r}
g007 <- df2 |> 
ggplot(mapping = aes(x = x, y = y)) +
 xlim(-15,25) + 
 ylim(0, 160) +
 geom_point(color = "blue", alpha = 0.5, 
  size = 2) +
 stat_smooth(formula = 'y ~ x', method = "lm", 
  se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 2) +
 labs(title = as.expression(
  bquote(~ R^2 == ~ 
 .(round(summary(lm(y~x, df2))$r.squared, 2)))
  )
) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18)
    )
```

```{r}
g021
```

```{r}
g007
```

```{r}
lm_cars <- lm(
  formula = 'dist ~ speed', 
  data = cars)
```

```{r}
# Y hat bar, fitted values
mean(fitted(lm_cars))
```

```{r}
# mean y
mean(cars$dist)
```

### Total variation

```{r}
sum((cars$dist - mean(cars$dist))^2)
```


### Explained variation

```{r}
# ESS, explained variation
sum((fitted(lm_cars) - mean(cars$dist))^2)
```

### unexplained variation

```{r}
# RSS, unexplained variation
# four ways to do it
sum(residuals(lm_cars)^2)
sum(pluck(lm_cars, "residuals")^2)
sum(lm_cars$residuals^2)
sum((cars$dist -pluck(lm_cars, "fitted.values"))^2)
```

```{r}
cor(cars$dist, lm_cars$fitted.values)
```

```{r}
cor(cars$dist, lm_cars$fitted.values)^2
```

```{r}
lm_cars |> 
  summary()
```

```{r}
summary_lm_cars <- summary(lm_cars)
```


```{r}
pluck(summary(lm_cars), "r.squared")
```

```{r}
cor(cars$dist, lm_cars$fitted.values)^2
```

```{r}
summary_lm_cars$r.squared == cor(cars$dist, lm_cars$fitted.values)^2
```

```{r}
near(summary_lm_cars$r.squared, cor(cars$dist, lm_cars$fitted.values)^2)
```
